## My Visualization
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = day, y = pressure, color = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()
  
```

## Big Question

Count the # of observations each year for hurricanes with windspeeds above the 75th percentile for observations/hurricanes windspeeds above the 75th percentile for observations/hurricanes in that year

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(threshold = quantile(wind, probs = 0.75)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(wind > threshold) |>
  count(year)

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
